stationId.description: Client-supplied station identifier; re-using an existing one upserts capabilities. Must be non-empty: the API treats "" as a missing field and rejects it with 400.

items.description: A null item is accepted and treated as an empty capability string (Go's JSON decoding cannot distinguish them).

locationCode.description: Optional facility-layout LocationCode identifying where this station physically sits (ADR-0024). Omitted entirely — or an explicit null, which is treated exactly the same — means unchecked: no role validation is attempted. When supplied and the location-role lookup is configured, a LocationCode that KNOWINGLY resolves to a role other than WorkCenter is rejected (422); an unrecognized LocationCode, or an unavailable lookup, fails open and is recorded unchecked.
